free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixes Python's random stream so the uniform draw at the target is deterministic across runs; it is not part of the claim.

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: Gives the constructor's single placeholder one dimension, so gen_ph_cons yields exactly one constraint and len(cons) == 1.

execution.entry_reason: The hand-off's official entry random_model_gen instantiates PureSymbolGen, whose post_process is a no-op; GuidedGen is never instantiated anywhere in the pinned repository, so the target cannot be reached through that entry. The target function GuidedGen.post_process is constructed directly (GuidedGen with one placeholder node) so the branch decision itself is exercised.
